summary: 翻译追求意义上的对应，但语境、目的和读者都会改变译者的选择。文章逐层比较不同程度的对应和逐词翻译等方式，最后讨论译者的工作与专业地位。
logic: 比较不同场合和翻译方式
讨论忠实度与译者地位

paragraphs.brief: 在一种语言( " 源语 " )的表达方式被变成另一种语言(目标语言)的含义时，无论介质是口头、书面还是签名的，都使用 " 翻译 " 一词。
sentences: The term ‘translation’ is used for all cases where the meaning of expressions in one language (the ‘source’ language) is turned into the meaning in another (the target language), whether the medium is spoken, written, or signed.
在一种语言( " 源语 " )的表达方式被变成另一种语言(目标语言)的含义时，无论介质是口头、书面还是签名的，都使用 " 翻译 " 一词。

In specific professional contexts, however, a distinction is drawn between work with the spoken or signed language (interpreting), and work with the written language (translating), although certain tasks blur this distinction.
然而，在具体专业方面，对使用口头或手语的工作(口译)和使用书面语言的工作(翻译)作了区分，尽管某些任务模糊了这种区分。

paragraphs.brief: 对目标语言也需要有同样的特别认识，以便特别措辞、当代表达方式、当地期望等等都能够得到考虑。
sentences: It is sometimes said that there is no task more complex than translation – a claim that can be readily believed when all the variables involved are taken into account.
有时有人说，没有比翻译更复杂的任务了，在考虑所有有关变数时可以很容易地相信这一说法。

Translators not only need to know their source language well; they must also have a thorough understanding of the field of knowledge covered by the source text, and of any social, cultural, or emotional connotations that need to be specified in the target language if the intended effect is to be conveyed.
笔译员不仅需要充分了解其原始语文；他们还必须透彻了解源文本所涵盖的知识领域，以及如果要传达预期效果，在目标语言中需要具体说明的任何社会、文化或情感内涵。

The same special awareness needs to be present for the target language, so that points of special phrasing, contemporary fashions in expression, local expectations, and so on, can all be taken into account.
对目标语言也需要有同样的特别认识，以便特别措辞、当代表达方式、当地期望等等都能够得到考虑。

On the whole, translators work into their mother tongue (or language of habitual use), to ensure a result that sounds as natural as possible – though some translators have argued that, for certain types of text (e.g., scientific material) where translation accuracy is more crucial than naturalness, it makes more sense for the translators to be more fluent in the source language.
总的来说，笔译员用母语(或习惯使用的语言)工作，以确保尽可能自然的结果 — — 尽管一些笔译员认为，对于翻译准确性比自然性更关键的某些类型的文本(如科学材料)而言，翻译更应该流利地使用源语。

paragraphs.brief: 翻译的目的是提供源语与目标语言之间的语义等同。
sentences: The aim of translation is to provide semantic equivalence between source and target languages.
翻译的目的是提供源语与目标语言之间的语义等同。
This is what makes translation different from other linguistic activities, such as adapting, précis writing, and abstracting.
这就是翻译与其他语言活动(如适应、简记和抽象)的不同之处。
However, there are many problems hidden within this apparently simple statement, all to do with what standards of ‘equivalence’ should be expected and accepted.
然而，这一显然简单的说法中隐藏了许多问题，所有这些问题都涉及 " 等同 " 的标准应该是什么来期待和接受。

paragraphs.brief: 当然，完全等同是不可能的：在节奏、语调和文化暗示等方面，任何翻译都无法提供与源文本完全平行的翻译。
sentences: Exact equivalence is of course impossible: no translator could provide a translation that was a perfect parallel to the source text, in such respects as rhythm, puns and cultural allusions.
当然，完全等同是不可能的：在节奏、语调和文化暗示等方面，任何翻译都无法提供与源文本完全平行的翻译。
Such a parallel is not even possible when paraphrasing within a single language: there is always some loss of information.
在单一语言中进行引言时甚至不可能有这种平行：总是有一些信息丢失。

paragraphs.brief: 科学文章的翻译需要认真注意含义，但很少注意文体特征。
sentences: On the other hand, there are many kinds of inexact equivalence, any of which can be successful at a certain level of practical functioning.
另一方面，存在着许多不确切的等同形式，任何一种等同形式都可以在某种实际运作水平上取得成功。
It therefore follows that there is no such thing as a ‘best’ translation.
因此，没有"最好的"翻译。
The success of translation depends on the purpose for which it was made, which in turn reflects the needs of the people for whom it was made.
翻译的成功取决于翻译的目的，而这又反映了翻译对象的需要。
A rough-and-ready translation of a letter can suffice to inform a firm of the nature of an enquiry.
信件的粗略和随时翻译足以使公司了解调查的性质。
A translation of a scientific article requires careful attention to meaning, but little attention to stylistic features.
科学文章的翻译需要认真注意含义，但很少注意文体特征。
The provision of a dubbed film script will warrant scrupulous care over the synchronisation of lip movements, often at the expense of content.
提供一部被称为电影的剧本，需要谨慎小心，避免嘴唇运动同步，而往往牺牲内容。
Literary work requires a sensitive consideration of form as well as content, and may prompt several translations, each of which emphasises a different aspect of the original.
文学工作要求对形式和内容进行敏感的考虑，并可能促使翻译数种，其中每种翻译都强调原件的不同方面。
It is easy to see that what might be ‘best’ for one set of circumstances may be entirely unsuitable for another.
很容易看出，对一种情况来说，" 最好 " 的东西可能完全不适合另一种情况。

paragraphs.brief: 并且有各种各样的语言翻译，目的是传达原始文本的结构风味，通常是用字面方式，强调诸如古老主义、辩证主义和手续的层次。
sentences: Several different kinds of translation have been proposed to allow for this range of possibilities.
提出了几种不同的翻译方法，以便提供这种可能性。
A pragmatic translation emphasises accuracy and knowledge of the subject, as required for instruction manuals and much scientific research.
实用的翻译强调该主题的准确性和知识，这是指导手册和大量科学研究所需要的。

In an aesthetic translation, important for literary material, the focus is on preserving the emotional as well as the cognitive content of the work, and on maintaining some level of stylistic equivalence.
在对文学材料十分重要的美学翻译中，重点是保存作品的情感和认知内容，并保持某种程度的文体等同。

Ethnographic or sociolinguistic translations aim to pay full attention to the cultural backgrounds of the authors and the recipients, and take into account differences between source and target languages, and the ways of life in which they are embedded.
民族学或社会语言学翻译旨在充分注意作者和接受者的文化背景，并考虑到源语言和目标语言之间的差异，以及他们所处的生活方式。

And there are various kinds of linguistic translation, where the aim is to convey the structural flavour of the original text, often in quite a literal manner, emphasising such features as archaisms, dialectisms, and levels of formality.
并且有各种各样的语言翻译，目的是传达原始文本的结构风味，通常是用字面方式，强调诸如古老主义、辩证主义和手续的层次。
Most translations, of course, are mixtures of these theoretical types, reflecting the complex reality of language in use.
当然，大多数译文都是这些理论类型的混合体，反映了所使用的语言的复杂现实。

paragraphs.brief: 在另一个层次，在逐字翻译的源语文中，每一词都用目标语文翻译。
sentences: At another level, in a word-for-word translation each word in the source language is translated by a word in the target language.
在另一个层次，在逐字翻译的源语文中，每一词都用目标语文翻译。
The result often makes no sense, especially when idiomatic constructions are used.
其结果往往不合理，特别是在使用特质结构时。
In a literal translation, the linguistic structure of the source text is followed, but is normalised according to the rules of the target language.
在字面翻译中，源文本的语言结构得到遵循，但根据目标语言的规则实现正常化。
In a free translation, the linguistic structure of the source language is ignored, and an equivalent is found based on the meaning it conveys.
在免费翻译中，源语言的语言结构被忽视，根据源语言所传达的含义发现等同语言。

paragraphs.brief: 有些国家认为翻译是一项卑劣的文秘任务，因此支付翻译费，而另一些国家则认为翻译本身是一项重要的知识纪律。
sentences: Translators aim to produce a text that is as faithful to the original as circumstances require or permit, and yet that reads as if it were written originally in the target language.
笔译员力求按情况要求或许可，制作一份忠实于原文的文本，但读作内容似乎最初是用目标语文写的。
They aim to be ‘invisible people’ – transferring content without drawing attention to the considerable artistic and technical skills involved in the process.
他们的目标是 " 隐形人 "，转移内容而不引起对这一过程所涉及的大量艺术和技术技能的注意。
The complexity of the task is apparent, but its importance is often underestimated, and its practitioners’ social status and legal rights undervalued.
这项任务的复杂性是显而易见的，但其重要性往往被低估，其从业人员的社会地位和法律权利被低估。
Some countries view translation as a menial, clerical task, and pay their translators accordingly, while others regard it as a major intellectual discipline in its own right.
有些国家认为翻译是一项卑劣的文秘任务，因此支付翻译费，而另一些国家则认为翻译本身是一项重要的知识纪律。
The question of status is currently much debated, particularly in Europe, where demand for translators is rocketing, especially in relation to the European Union.
地位问题目前受到激烈辩论，特别是在欧洲，那里对笔译员的需求激增，特别是在欧洲联盟方面。

items.en: the effect that a client’s requirements have on the nature of a translation
items.zh: 客户的要求对翻译性质的影响
items.why: E 段把译文是否合适与委托目的联系起来，而委托目的取决于使用者的需要，直接解释客户要求为何会改变翻译方式。
H 段对比不同国家的态度：有的把翻译当作普通文书工作，有的则把它视为重要智力活动，还由此产生不同职业待遇。

items.en: a list of the areas of knowledge studied by translators
items.zh: 翻译所研究的知识领域清单
items.why: B 段列出译者需要掌握的范围，包括源语言、原文所属的专业知识，以及文字背后的社会、文化和情感含义。

items.en: Which THREE of the following points are mentioned by the writer of the passage?
items.zh: 文章作者提到下列三点中的哪一点？
correct: A translator may need to consider the culture of the target language.
翻译可能需要考虑目标语言的文化。
It is difficult to specify what constitutes a very good translation.
很难具体说明什么是非常好的翻译。
A translation should give the impression of being an original work.
译文应给人一种原始工作的印象。
